incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED — partial egress failure in us-east-1c. Multiple instances in subnet subnet-0a1b2c are unable to reach internet via NAT gateway nat-0f1e2d. PagerDuty: https://pd.example/INC12345
Sophia: grabbing it, oncall here. seeing alerts for increased 503s from inference-sidecars in us-east-1c.
Raj: I'm looking at VPC route tables now. Not receiving route propagation from the TransitGW for that AZ.
Alice: paging infra oncall to confirm NAT healthchecks, @Raj do you have NAT gw id?
Raj: nat-0f1e2d. Health check shows UP in console but ASG logs show connections timing out. Strange mismatch.
Miguel: hit the metrics — egress error rate spikes starting 02:12Z. 12k failed external connections, 18% of capacity in that AZ. Customers hitting inference API get 502/504.
Sophia: customer impact: several mid-market tenants reported degraded requests; support stack has 8 open tickets blaming timeouts. Flagging high priority.
Raj: running quick describe: ```bash
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0abc" "Name=association.subnet-id,Values=subnet-0a1b2c" --query 'RouteTables[].Routes'
```
Alice: route table shows 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0f1e2d, but route state says `blackhole` for propagated route from tgw-0aa.
Raj: checking TGW attachments for use-east-1c — propagation entries show `stale` for route table rtb-0c3d. Looks like propagation stopped at 02:10Z.
Sophia: possible causes: TGW control plane flapped, or route table association failed during a prior rollout. Any recent infra deploys?
Miguel: deploy-bot shows a route automation change at 01:58Z that attempted to rotate NATs across AZs (PR #987). Could be a race.
oncall-pagerduty: Paging escalation to SRE secondary — @Raj, you have 10 minutes to acknowledge.
Raj: ack. I'm going to apply a manual fallback: re-associate subnet to fallback route table rtb-fallback-azc which points 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0d3c2b.
Alice: do it in steps, let's confirm the fallback gw is healthy: `aws ec2 describe-nat-gateways --nat-gateway-ids nat-0d3c2b` — shows Available, baseline throughput ok.
Raj: performing association: ```bash
aws ec2 associate-route-table --subnet-id subnet-0a1b2c --route-table-id rtb-fallback-azc
```
Sophia: taking notes for postmortem: time of mitigation attempt 02:22Z. Notify Customer Ops to update status page.
Customer-Ops: preparing status page update — will note: "Partial egress interruption in us-east-1c; mitigation in progress; some API requests may fail."
Miguel: after association, health improved on some instances, but we still see intermittent failures for legacy instances behind the old route.
Raj: discovered that some instances were pinned to the old route table via explicit association (we missed one subnet association in the automation). Re-associating that subnet now.
Alice: also check network ACLs — automation changed NACL rules earlier that tightened ephemeral ports for that AZ. Could be blocking return traffic. `aws ec2 describe-network-acls --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0abc`
Raj: NACL shows a DENY on ephemeral port range 32768-61000 for subnet-0a1b2c introduced in PR #987. Rolling that back now.
Miguel: rolling back NACL change — updating rule to allow ephemeral range. Doing it via console to be faster.
Sophia: good. After both steps we should see stable egress. Monitor 1-2 mins and check client error rate.
Raj: re-run connectivity test from a bastion in that subnet: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://example.com` -> returns 200 now.
Miguel: CloudWatch shows error rate dropping; 5xx count at 02:28Z is down 80% from peak.
Alice: Customer Ops, update status page with ETA: 10-15 min to fully recover and mention partial impact resolved.
Customer-Ops: updated. message: "Mitigation underway; partial recovery observed. We'll keep monitoring and provide ETA for full restoration"
incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status: mitigation in progress — responders: Sophia, Raj, Alice, Miguel.
Sophia: assigning postmortem owners: Raj (network root cause), Alice (automation pipeline race), Miguel (monitoring & alerts tuning).
Raj: quick note — the automation attempted `AssociateRouteTable` during a TGW propagation window; race led to stale propagation entry + NACL tightening. We'll add guards.
Alice: filing rollback and pipeline fix: add a check to verify TGW propagation state before switching route associations. Link PR coming.
Miguel: tuning alert thresholds: raise egress-health alert to page on 5-min sustained error increase >5% and include affected AZ tag.
Sophia: oncall handoff — I'm handing incident to Raj at 02:35Z to lead recovery and run the RCA write-up. I'll stay on watch for customer comms.
Raj: taking it. final check: all subnets in us-east-1c show 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0d3c2b and NACLs allowing ephemeral ports. Rolling monitoring to green.
Miguel: last_message: CloudWatch alarms quieting, connections normalizing at 02:39Z. Recommend waiting 30m before declaring resolved.
Sophia: agreed. I'll mark as "mitigation complete — monitoring" and schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC12345 updated: mitigation in progress -> monitoring.
